### 2026-10-11 – I organised the parts on the pcb. This consists of all the capacitors, resistors, the fpc connector for the eink, 4 leds, esp32 c3 mini, a usbc port and a connector for the lipo so it would be easy to

**1.07h**

I organised the parts on the pcb. This consists of all the capacitors, resistors, the fpc connector for the eink, 4 leds, esp32 c3 mini, a usbc port and a connector for the lipo so it would be easy to interchange. I wasnt sure about wether I should go for a e ink display or a oled because oled also allows for like animations but in the end I chose e ink because it would last much longer on a single charge and I would value that more as the overall size would also be less due to a smaller lipo.
